title: Neon Function Registry Template
description: A self-describing Neon Function template. Source code is not inlined: operations and assets name files that live under this template's folder.

depth.description: Implementation depth. The console badges 'scaffold' templates so they are not presented as complete.

items.description: Exact name@version pin (no ranges or dist-tags).

dependsOn.description: Ids of other templates this one requires installed first (foundations like queue). The installer resolves the transitive closure and installs in this order; independent blocks have an empty list.

required.description: Whether the install form must collect a value. Injected variables are never required of the user.

secret.description: Render as a secret input and never echo the value. Defaults to false.

injected.description: Supplied automatically by Neon (DATABASE_URL, storage, AI gateway). The form must NOT prompt for these; show them as provided. Defaults to false.

default.description: Prefilled default for an optional variable.

example.description: Illustrative value for the form's placeholder. Not a default.

type.description: Data type, for input coercion and validation before deploy.

widget.description: Form control the console should render for this variable.

triggers.description: Cron and storage triggers the block needs. The function-deploy API does not create these; the installer creates them per entry after deploy.

source.description: Relative path to the operation module under this template folder.

recommended.description: Whether this operation is part of the recommended default set. At least one operation must be true.
